subject.title: feat: Add Anthropic server-side compaction API support

question: Should Anthropic native compaction use provider-specific per-model parameters or extend the shared `agents.defaults.compaction` contract, and should a compaction stop automatically continue the active turn?
rationale: These choices establish public configuration and session-loop behavior; neither can be safely inferred from the provider API or existing local compaction registry.

options.title: Provider-specific model parameters
options.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in parameters and an explicit continuation policy without broadening the shared compaction schema.

options.title: Shared compaction mode
options.body: Extend `agents.defaults.compaction` with provider-native settings and define common semantics that future providers must follow.

options.title: Defer native integration
options.body: Keep local compaction as the supported path until a broader provider-native context-management design is approved.

recommendation.title: Provider-specific model parameters
recommendation.body: Add Anthropic-specific opt-in parameters and an explicit continuation policy without broadening the shared compaction schema.

likelyOwner.reason: This person has the strongest combined connection to the Anthropic transport, compaction configuration, and existing item-level product discussion.
